content:
Robin (Finance): Heads-up — saw a renewal invoice for AcmeCorp (INV-2026-0456) that charged the platform fee for January twice. Looks like we billed both the old SKU 'private-enterprise' and new 'private_v2' during a SKU relabel. Duplicate platform fee amount: $18,000. Anyone aware of a migration window that would justify both charges?

Jules (Accounting): Can you paste the invoice line items and PO? Need to map to contract.

Robin (Finance): Quick paste from the invoice PDF:
```
INV-2026-0456
line 1: private-enterprise | platform-fee | $18,000
line 2: private_v2         | platform-fee | $18,000
```
PO: PO-9988. Contract: SOW 2024-ACME (MSA refs platform fee per environment).

Lina (Sales): We did a SKU rename during renewal and I approved the relabel in the renewal worksheet. I didn't realize our billing pipeline would emit separate line items — I thought it would de-duplicate.

Ana (Legal): If this is a relabel with no additional contractual service, sounds like the customer was double-billed and we should credit. @revops / @finance confirm.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0456 status: PAID (2026-01-15). Note: billing system creates charges per active SKU tag at invoice close.

Mateo (Eng): We rolled the SKU over over a 72h window and both tags were briefly active in the catalog. Fault on our side — we forgot to set the old SKU to alias/deprecated before invoice generation. Hence two platform-fee lines. Sorry about that.

Jules (Accounting): Since invoice is already paid, we'll need approval to issue a negative invoice (credit note). Confirm credit amount to be issued equals duplicate platform fee ($18,000)?

Robin (Finance): I recommend issuing the full $18,000 credit for the duplicated platform-fee line. This matches customer expectation and avoids churn — we'll follow up with internal RCA and a billing fix.

Lina (Sales): +1. Customer already flagged CSR and asked for corrected invoice.

Ana (Legal): I support the credit. Please include a clear explanation referencing "SKU alias overlap" and internal ticket #BILL-867. Finance+Sales sign-off required before issuance.

Robin (Finance): @Jules please create credit note referencing INV-2026-0456, amount $18,000, reason: "SKU alias overlap duplication". I'll route for exec approval if needed.

Jules (Accounting): Creating credit note now — will attach to the original invoice and push refund to payment method on file. ETA ~24h. @Mateo can you update the rollout checklist so SKU aliases are auto-merged and not double-invoiced?

Mateo (Eng): Will add the checklist item and ship a small guard in billing service to dedupe platform-fee lines when alias mappings exist. Filed INF-2345 (billing dedupe for SKU alias).

Robin (Finance): Thanks — please cc support and sales on the customer communication. I'll close the loop once the credit is posted. Anyone object to the wording?

Lina (Sales): 👍

Ana (Legal): 👍

Jules (Accounting): Credit created: CN-2026-0012, refund processed to card on file. Marking this resolved and closing the ticket.

Robin (Finance): Great, thanks all. I'll file a short postmortem and add the SKU alias test to the renewal playbook.
